Today unfolded as a measured test of Alex’s reserves. His introverted nature and moderate psychological safety meant social interactions and digital demands drained him steadily. Alex held a guarded posture—engaged enough to meet expectations but cautious, wary of judgment and overstimulation. The day’s texture was one of careful persistence amid low affect, a typical narrative of his ongoing adjustment in a demanding environment.
